svg.title: Small predictor columns can hide an order-one collective action
svg.desc: For a repeated scalar filter, every column of the predictor matrix stays small, proportional to the input scale. Yet its action on a normalized all-ones vector approaches norm one as the sequence grows. The solid curves show this lower bound for three input scales, while dotted curves show the maximum column norms.
svg.text: Scalar repeated-vector case of the family 097 predictor; each finite curve comes from an exact formula.
number of repeated vectors n (log scale)
solid: all-ones lower bound on operator norm
Analytic formulas and source-scope caveat in note 32 · diagonal energy controls columns, not the full operator norm · Lattice
